picks.title: Copper Drakes for Black Crystal Ore
picks.why: Black Crystal Ore is the priciest ore by far this week, around 3,000 mesos each. Copper Drakes are weak to ice, so I/L Wizards clear them fastest. Maladies in The Forest of Evil II drop it too if you're 55+.

picks.title: Fire Boars for four kinds of loot
picks.why: Almost everything a Fire Boar drops sells, and Iron Ore (about 400) is the priciest common ore right now. Great for warriors and bowmen right after 2nd job.

picks.title: Stirges for Iron Ore early
picks.why: The earliest way to farm Iron Ore. Stirges fly, so ranged and magic attacks have it easiest. Transfer Area in the Kerning subway has them too.

picks.title: Bubblings for Mithril while you level
picks.why: You're already here for EXP from 15 to 20, so keep the Mithril. It sells to crafters for more than most ores this low.

tips: Check what things actually sold for, not what people ask in megaphones. Asking prices run high.
Look at two sites before you sell anything rare. If they disagree, the lower number is closer to what you'll get.
Keep ores, leather and screws. Players pay far more than NPCs do.
Got a Fairy Wing, Piece of Ice or Moon Rock? Those are the priciest crafting materials on this page right now (about 96,000, 39,500 and 30,000 mesos). Sell them to players, never to an NPC.
Ores dropped hard this week (Garnet Ore is around 220 now, after about 890 over the last two weeks), so don't sit on a big stack waiting for a bounce.
Undercut by a little, not a lot. A few mesos under the cheapest shop is enough to sell fast.
